title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Mark 10: the question about divorce, the little children, the rich man who went away sorrowful, the request of James and John and blind Bartimaeus.

questions.text: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus in order to test him?
questions.explanation: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife.

answers.text: Whether it is lawful to heal on the Sabbath
Whether it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife
Whether a man should pay the tax
Whether the dead will rise again

questions.text: What did Jesus say about what God has joined together?
questions.explanation: He said, "What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate."

answers.text: A man may separate it if he wishes
Only the husband may separate it
It may be separated in the house
No man should separate it

questions.text: What did Jesus say when the disciples rebuked those bringing little children?
questions.explanation: He was moved with indignation and said to allow the little children to come to him and not to forbid them, for God's Kingdom belongs to such as these.

answers.text: To bring them back the next day
To teach them the commandments first
To let the little children come to him
To send them away with their mothers

questions.text: What did the man who ran to him and knelt down ask?
questions.explanation: He asked, "Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?"

answers.text: What he should do to inherit eternal life
Whether he could follow him to Jerusalem
Whether his sins could be forgiven
What the greatest commandment was

questions.text: What one thing did Jesus say the man lacked?
questions.explanation: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and told him to go, sell whatever he had, give to the poor, and come follow him.

answers.text: To be baptized by John
To sell what he had and give to the poor
To honor his father and mother
To fast and pray for the poor

questions.text: Why did the man go away sorrowful?
questions.explanation: His face fell at that saying and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

answers.text: He had no father or mother
He had broken all the commandments
He had great possessions
He was too old to travel

questions.text: What did Jesus say is easier than for a rich man to enter God's Kingdom?
questions.explanation: He said it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into God's Kingdom.

answers.text: For a camel to go through a needle's eye
For a mountain to be cast into the sea
For a fig tree to bear fruit in winter
For a blind man to see the stars

questions.text: What did James and John ask Jesus to grant them?
questions.explanation: They asked to sit, one at his right hand and one at his left hand, in his glory.

answers.text: To be sent out to preach alone
To see him change on the mountain
To be given a place in Jerusalem
To sit at his right and left hand in his glory

questions.text: Why did Jesus say the Son of Man came?
questions.explanation: He said that the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

answers.text: To be served by all the nations of the earth
To serve and to give his life as a ransom for many
To judge the rulers of the nations
To restore the kingdom of his father David

questions.text: What did Bartimaeus cry out as Jesus went out from Jericho?
questions.explanation: Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, a blind beggar sitting by the road, cried out, "Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"

answers.text: "Jesus the Nazarene, call me to you!"
"Teacher, have mercy on your servant!"
"Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"
"Son of Mary, heal me, I beg you!"
